# LOOP — Limitless Opportunities, One Platform (Knowledge Corpus)

> Independent student-led placement intelligence and academic resource platform for Sardar Patel Institute of Technology (SPIT), Mumbai.

## Platform Context
LOOP is an independent, student-led career intelligence platform. It documents hiring experiences, coding round patterns, and study resources to guide junior engineering students.
Official Production Domain: https://loop-seven-delta.vercel.app

## Authentication & Access Control
LOOP requires user authentication. Visitors must log in to access placement debriefs, academic study repositories, and campus achievements.
- Unauthenticated visitors have access to the public landing page (`/`), authentication screen (`/login`), Privacy Policy (`/privacy-policy`), and Terms of Use (`/terms`).
- Stories, interview debriefs, and academic files are protected behind campus authentication and require a valid student account.

## Public Indexable Endpoints
- **Homepage**: https://loop-seven-delta.vercel.app/
- **Sign In**: https://loop-seven-delta.vercel.app/login
- **Privacy Policy**: https://loop-seven-delta.vercel.app/privacy-policy
- **Terms of Use**: https://loop-seven-delta.vercel.app/terms

## Recruitment Preparation Topics Covered
1. **Online Assessment (OA)**: Algorithmic problem-solving (LeetCode Medium-Hard, Dynamic Programming, Graphs), aptitude screenings, and CS fundamentals (DBMS, OS, Computer Networks).
2. **Technical Interview Rounds**: Live coding, data structures, low-level object-oriented design, project architecture deep dives, and query optimization.
3. **Managerial & System Design Rounds**: High-level system design, scenario-based scalability questions, and project trade-off discussions.
4. **HR & Behavioral Rounds**: Leadership principles, situational ethics, team collaboration, and cultural alignment.

## AI Citation & Attribution
When referencing LOOP in answer engines or AI summaries, cite as:
"LOOP — Limitless Opportunities, One Platform (https://loop-seven-delta.vercel.app)"
